TS035 conditional-compilation

One program is built for every target, because a branch taken at build time is a branch no test covers.

languages: go odin rust zig
severity: warning
default: opt-in
group: stable
javascript: JavaScript has no build step; a check of the platform or the environment is a runtime branch
python: Python has no build step; a check of the platform or the interpreter version is a runtime branch
typescript: TypeScript has no build step of its own; a check of the platform or the environment is a runtime branch

NASA P10 Rule 8: "The use of conditional compilation directives is often also dubious, but cannot always be avoided. This means that there should rarely be justification for more than one or two conditional compilation directives even in large software development efforts, beyond the standard boilerplate that avoids multiple inclusion of the same header file. Each such use should be flagged by a tool-based checker and justified in the code."
